retrievalProfile.description: Produces a warm, soft-focus studio portrait with a mottled blue-grey background and elegant script typography in the upper corners.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a smiling subject with feathered hair, illuminated by warm, diffused light against a textured, cool-toned studio backdrop. The composition is balanced by delicate, white script lettering positioned at the top left and right edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones and orange clothing contrasting against a cool blue-grey background
Soft-focus diffusion softening the edges of the subject and hair
Hand-resting-on-chin pose creating a triangular compositional base
Symmetrical placement of script text in the upper third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, medium shot from the chest up, filling approximately 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile, highlighted by the warmest light.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face to the hand gesture, then upward to the script text in the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and sides provide breathing room with a textured, painterly quality.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Terracotta and warm orange (clothing and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Medium saturation with a compressed value range to maintain a soft, hazy look.

letterConstructionRules: Elongated, flourishing swashes on initial and terminal characters
Connected lowercase letters with looped ascenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature large, circular flourishes
Terminal 'y' or 'e' extends into a long, decorative underline or tail

typesetting.alignment: left and right justified to corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script style used for both name and title to maintain elegance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, high-contrast cursive style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a person with 1970s feathered hair, wearing an orange textured top, against a mottled blue-grey backdrop with warm lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white, elegant script lettering in the top-left and top-right corners using a thin, flourishing cursive font.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and diffused?
Is the background mottled and cool-toned?
Is the typography thin, white, and script-based?
Is there a visible soft-focus/hazy effect?

adjustableVariables: Warmth of the terracotta color palette
postGenerationChecks: Ensure script does not overlap the subject's face
Verify the soft-focus does not obscure facial features
Confirm the color contrast between orange and blue-grey
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus 1970s portrait + mottled cool backdrop + warm terracotta lighting + corner-aligned white script.
